name: loki
description: GPU-aware VOD preparation, evidence-linked reports and local review by the current Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Read VOD sources and author evidence-linked reports
interface.longDescription: The current Codex prepares public VOD sources, directly reads originals and selected frames, authors a local report, and opens the existing review UI. Includes GPU-aware local speech and multimodal setup, image extraction, runtime and skill. No separate author-model transport, live scheduler or external publisher.
defaultPrompt: Use Loki to read my prepared VOD sources and create an evidence-linked summary, timeline, Stories and Highlights.
